description:
Analyze APM traces for request flow and latency debugging. Actions: search (find spans), aggregate (group stats), services (list APM services). Key filters: minDuration/maxDuration ("500ms", "2s"), httpStatus ("5xx", ">=400"), status (ok/error), errorMessage (grep).
APM METRICS: Traces auto-generate metrics in trace.<operation>.* namespace (e.g. trace.express.request). Use metrics tool to query: avg:trace.express.request.duration{service:my-service}. For percentiles (p95), use the root metric WITHOUT .duration suffix: p95:trace.express.request{service:my-service}

errorMessage.description: Filter by error message (grep-like). Example: "timeout", "connection refused"

from.description: Start time. Formats: ISO 8601, relative (30s, 15m, 2h, 7d), precise (3d@11:45:23, yesterday@14:00)

groupBy.description: Fields to group by (for aggregate). Example: ["resource_name", "status"]

minDuration.description: Minimum span duration (find slow spans). Examples: "1s", "500ms", "100ms"

query.description: APM trace search query (Datadog syntax). Example: "@http.status_code:500", "service:my-service status:error"

resource.description: Filter by resource name (endpoint/query). Supports wildcards. Example: "GET /api/*", "*orders*"

status.description: Filter by span status - "ok" for successful, "error" for failed spans

to.description: End time. Same formats as "from". Example: from="3d@11:45" to="3d@12:55"

name: traces
